description: Universal multi-language runner and smart REPL written in Rust.

summary.one_liner: A Rust command-line tool that runs code in 25 programming languages through one consistent interface, with a persistent multi-language REPL.
keywords: run python go rust js from one tool
alternative to docker for running snippets
use_cases: Run a quick snippet in Python, Go, Rust, or another supported language without installing extra tooling
Prototype or test algorithms across several languages from one CLI
Teach or learn programming with a consistent run command across languages
Pipe JSON or text into a snippet in another language for scripting
Re-run a source file automatically on change while developing
Use an interactive REPL that switches between languages and keeps session variables
notable: Single CLI covers 25 languages by shelling out to each language's real toolchain
Persistent REPL with per-language history and :lang switching between languages mid-session
--json output envelope and --timeout flag for scripting and automation
Persistent blake3-based build cache with stats and clear commands
Experimental Run 2.0 adds WASI 0.2 component builds, dev, test, and registry publish
caveats: Each language requires its own compiler or interpreter installed and on PATH; run does not bundle them
Run 2.0 is experimental and opt-in, requires the v2 feature flag
Kotlin needs kotlinc plus a JRE; Deno, Dart, and Node are needed for their respective aliases
